name: MSSP (Managed Security Service Provider)
description: Provider organizations managing multiple client tenant orgs under a delegated-access model: client provisioning (tenant-provisioning.service.js), cross-org dashboard/usage/billing consolidation, subscription-change request workflow, compliance-framework licensing, provider team & invitations, ownership detach/transfer, append-only audit trail, and hard portal/tenant boundary isolation (portalBoundary.js + client-panel middleware.js) so MSSP and customer users can never cross into each other's routes. Spans vibrantix-backend, vibrantix-client-panel, the standalone vibrantix-partner-portal app, and vibrantix-admin-panel.
